edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve all claims.
1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff [SETTLEMENT AMOUNT] by [PAYMENT DEADLINE], by [AGREED PAYMENT METHOD] to an account designated by Plaintiff in writing.

2. RELEASE. Upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases all claims against Defendant arising on or before the effective date of this Agreement. This release does not extend to obligations under this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this settlement confidential, except for disclosures to legal, tax, and financial advisers who are bound by confidentiality obligations, disclosures required by law or legal process, or disclosures reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. Nothing in this Agreement prohibits lawful reporting to or cooperation with governmental authorities.

edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve only the Released Claims defined below. “Effective Date” means the date on which the last of Harrow and Delmar signs this Agreement. “Business Day” means a day other than Saturday, Sunday, or a United States federal holiday.
edits.name: Defined parties and effective date

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant Delmar shall pay Plaintiff Harrow $25,000 (the “Settlement Amount”) by wire transfer in immediately available funds within 15 Business Days after the Effective Date. Plaintiff shall provide written wire instructions promptly after execution, and Defendant shall independently verify those instructions using a previously established contact method. If Plaintiff provides verified instructions fewer than five Business Days before the payment deadline, that deadline shall extend to five Business Days after verified instructions are provided. Defendant shall bear its sending-bank charges; payment is complete when Plaintiff receives the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds. If payment is not timely received, Plaintiff shall give written notice of nonpayment to Defendant and its counsel at the notice email addresses specified in the signature blocks. Defendant shall have five Business Days after receipt to cure. After an uncured default, Plaintiff may either enforce the unpaid settlement obligation or terminate this Agreement by written notice and pursue the Released Claims, but may not obtain double recovery. Any amounts paid shall be credited against recovery. In an action to enforce the payment obligation following an uncured default, the prevailing party may recover reasonable attorneys’ fees and costs.
edits.name: Proposed economics and nonpayment remedies

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. “Released Claims” means only Harrow’s claims against Delmar arising from the specific acts, transactions, and events identified in Exhibit A occurring on or before the Effective Date, including known and unknown claims arising from those identified matters. Exhibit A shall identify any pending action by caption, court, and case number, describe the underlying dispute, and specify any excluded claims. Exhibit A must be completed and agreed before either party executes this Agreement. Upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Harrow, solely on Harrow’s own behalf, releases the Released Claims against Delmar only. No other person is a releasor or released party. This release excludes obligations under this Agreement, claims arising from conduct after the Effective Date, and claims that cannot lawfully be released. Until payment in full, the Released Claims remain unreleased.
edits.name: Precisely bounded release
